background_story: Dominick was a small remora fish, commonly known as a sharksucker, who lived in the vibrant coral reefs of the Caribbean. He spent most of his days swimming alongside a majestic tiger shark named Scar, feeding on the leftover plankton and small crustaceans from Scar's meals. Despite their size difference, Dominick and Scar formed an unlikely yet harmonious bond. Dominick would often attach himself to Scar's body, using his suction cup-like mouth to hold tight, and ride the currents together. As they glided through the ocean, Dominick would keep Scar's skin clean, removing parasites and dead skin, earning his keep as a loyal companion. Scar, in turn, provided Dominick with protection and a constant food supply. Their symbiotic relationship was a testament to the unique friendships that could be found in the underwater world.
